### `reactor_auxiliary_reactor`

**Reactor - Auxiliary Reactor**, Halvorsen Power Systems, part HPS-REA-1226 (producer)

* Mass 7.41 t; size 2090 x 2348 x 1300 mm; heat 820 kW.
* Output 2720 kW at 6.6 kVAC 3ph; own load 22 kW.
* Price 10.9 M cr, lead time 165 days, MTBF 82,600 h, service every 4,000 h, service life 25 years, crew 2.
* IP54, -20 to 55 C, 82 dB(A); certifications: CSA-M5 machinery safety, CSA-E24 electrical safety, CSA-R3 radiation (fusion); interface: Power management bus PMB-1.
* floor-mounted, free-standing. Install with a hoist or gantry (7.41 t). Output 2.72 MW at 6.6 kVAC 3ph; connect only through its breaker panel.
